channel.title: Fan（凡）’s Log
channel.description: A bilingual field notebook on human–AI interaction, knowledge work, and attentive living. 一本记录人机交互、知识工作与专注生活的双语田野笔记。

item.title: Interfaces as Epistemic Partners / 作为认识伙伴的界面
item.description: An interface does more than deliver answers: it shapes what can be questioned, inspected, and revised. 界面不只传递答案，也塑造什么可以被追问、检查与修正。

item.title: Calibrating Trust in AI Assistance / 校准对 AI 助手的信任
item.description: Trustworthy interaction is not about maximizing confidence, but helping people rely on an output appropriately. 可信交互不是让人尽可能相信系统，而是帮助人对具体输出形成恰当依赖。

item.title: The Quiet Work of Attention / 注意力的静默工作
item.description: Attention does more than select an object. It gives experience enough time to acquire edges and weight. 注意力不只选择对象，也让经验获得足够的时间，慢慢显出边缘与重量。
